title: Bimetallic thermostats and thermal cutouts for use with electric irons
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the general, safety and performance requirements of thermostats and thermal cutout of the bimetallic type for use with electric irons intended for use on ac circuits at voltages not exceeding 250 V and current rating not exceeding 10 Amps.
clause_3_terminology: Bimetallic thermostats and thermal cutouts for use with electric irons
